decisions.quote: `fieldGroup` is the current child-field collection; `fieldArray` is the template or function used to create item fields. A `FieldArrayType` implementation registers a FormArray, sizes its fieldGroup to the model array, clones each item config, and assigns index keys when applicable [K12](sources.md#k12).
decisions.rationale: K12 verified: existing control reuse/new FormArray is keyed; null item keys are retained. Draft bounded construction fact. Independent source-mapping review pending.

decisions.quote: A working repeater requires a rendering component and a registered type. The official example's `type: 'repeat'` is registered to `RepeatTypeComponent`, which extends `FieldArrayType`; core does not make that particular name universally available [E01](examples.md#e01), [K03](sources.md#k03).
decisions.rationale: E01a/b/c and K03 verified. Scope to official repeat string alias; direct component classes do not universally require an alias. Existing general registration facts reused. Independent source-mapping review pending.

decisions.quote: Use the array type's `add(index?, initialModel?, options?)` and `remove(index, options?)` when implementing its UI. These operations update model/field collections, rebuild, emit changes, and normally mark the control dirty. Manually splicing only fieldGroup bypasses some of that coordination [K12](sources.md#k12).
decisions.rationale: K12 verified: model mutation, rebuild and event sequence, conditional dirty marking and removal key updates. Valid initialized model/index conditions retained. Independent source-mapping review pending.

decisions.quote: Important exact-version detail: this implementation tests `initialModel` for truthiness before cloning it. Do not assume passing false, zero, or an empty string to `add` preserves that scalar unchanged; establish the intended model shape and verify that use case [K12](sources.md#k12).
decisions.rationale: K12 verified: undefined insertion branch for falsy initialModel; post-build/default outcomes are not fixed by this branch. Independent source-mapping review pending.

decisions.quote: When adapting the official repeater to Material, preserve the array component logic and registration, replace Bootstrap layout/button assumptions, and test add/remove/reset/hide on the exact target stack. Do not just copy the example's `type: 'repeat'` field into a Material app and omit its component.
